provenance.source: Independent numeric-only measurements of privately emulated user-owned Mega Drive ROM

model.activation: City stage on map, hold R and press A (SDL dash+select)
model.horizontal_model: vx_next = vx + response * (requested_speed - vx); x_next = x + vx_next
model.jump_model: vy0 = -28.5*g; vy_next = vy + g; y_next = y + vy_next

scope_limits: Model acceleration and ballistic gravity fitted to sparse observations: not recovered Genesis opcodes or exact fixed-point physics
Switch synthetic stage coordinate origin and floor layout differ from original city level
Uncalibrated features include dash, red plunger, collisions, wall slides, pickups, enemy behavior and camera
No original ROM bytes, sprites, music or RAM contents embedded
